headline: Mistral releases open weights for trillion‑parameter model

items.note: Free: Instagram Content Publishing API (Instagram Login, Meta developer app)
items.text:
Mistral releases open weights for trillion-parameter model

• Mistral makes its 1-trillion-parameter model weights publicly available, enabling self-hosted, cost-efficient AI for coding and cyber defense.
• Google Gemini now lets all users edit PDFs, Docs, Sheets and more directly inside chat, starting 29 October 2026.
• AWS plans $220 billion capex in 2026 and targets 40 percent annual revenue growth on the way to becoming a trillion-dollar revenue business.

Full five-minute read, every claim sourced: link in bio (fiveminuteai.net)
